csv_scope_of_work: CIVIL/STRUCTURALENGINEERING CONSULTING SERVICES. Pinellas County Construction & Property Management (CPM) is seeking Qualifications Statements for Continuing Civil/Structural Engineering Services from interested Consultants licensed and qualified by the State of Florida to provide professional engineering services. From time to time, CPM needs to retain professional civil/structural engineering services for a variety of studies, designs, and other related services. Services will be assigned as specific tasks to accomplish a described scope of work required for each task

title: On-Call Pinellas County Civil/Structural Engineering
short_description: On-call civil and structural engineering services for various county studies and design tasks.
project_scope: Continuing on-call civil/structural engineering consulting services for Pinellas County Construction & Property Management. The contract covers a variety of future task-based assignments including studies, designs, and related professional engineering services for county projects. No specific structure, building type, span, floor area, or individual project scope is defined in the notice.
services: Professional civil and structural engineering consulting services on an as-needed basis; task orders for studies, design services, and related engineering services.
relevance_explanation:
- General on-call framework-style consulting contract without a defined technical project.
- No specific bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building is identified.
- Scope is broad and unspecific, reducing strategic fit for sbp.
- Although structural engineering is included, the notice appears focused on continuing county support rather than a distinctive design opportunity.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice is for continuing on-call consulting services with future task assignments, and no individual project scope, size, or cost basis is provided for a realistic estimate.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. The notice only indicates a 60-month continuing services contract with task-based assignments; no upset limit, task volume, or engineering fee basis is provided.
references_qualifications: Consultants must be licensed and qualified by the State of Florida to provide professional engineering services. The notice requests qualifications statements for continuing civil/structural engineering services. No detailed reference counts or project-specific qualification thresholds are provided in the source text.
